titre: A free rook on h8. Should he take it? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Vienna Game, Stanley variation. White grabs the undefended rook on h8, and Black mates in 3: Qg4+, Nxc2+ forking king and rook, then Qd1#. After Qg4+ White has only two replies, and both lose. White was already better: 9.c3 was right. Seen in 2 real Lichess games (~1740). Would you have taken the rook? 👇
